ECHO Character Lab — attribution

BASE AVATAR
mpfb.glb from https://github.com/met4citizen/TalkingHead
Original asset: https://github.com/met4citizen/TalkingHead/blob/main/avatars/mpfb.glb
The source README identifies this MPFB/Blender model as CC0.
This lab resizes textures and replaces clothing material and eye geometry at runtime.
The underlying base character is not original commissioned ECHO artwork.
TalkingHead runtime code is not included.

RENDERING
Three.js r170, MIT license. Full license: ../vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js

AUDIO
Original ECHO dialogue synthesized offline using Piper, en_US-ljspeech-high.
Voice model card: https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/blob/main/en/en_US/ljspeech/high/MODEL_CARD
Dataset identified by the model card: LJSpeech, public domain.
Repository: https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices (MIT).
Only generated recordings and sample-aligned phoneme cues are distributed here;
no voice model or synthesis runtime is bundled. No voice API is called.

Custom lab interface, shaders and performance choreography created for this prototype.
